newsitem.title: USA: FTC official cites press reports on Boeing merger.
newsitem.headline: FTC official cites press reports on Boeing merger.

text.p: A Federal Trade Commission official said Wednesday he had seen press reports that the European Union may require Boeing try to sell McDonnell Douglas Corp's commercial airplane unit before it merges with McDonnell.
But Bill Baer, who heads the competition bureau at the FTC, emphasized that he had no first hand knowledge whether those press reports were true.

"Based on press reports, not on any conversation I've had with my colleagues in Europe, I understand that they (EU officials) have suggested that there ought to be a period of time of six months or so in which an effort is made to find an alternative buyer for Douglas Aircraft, to see if there could be a buyer out there," he told a United States Information Agency Foreign Press Center press conference.
"If there is no buyer, Boeing would be allowed to go through and complete the purchase, at least that's my understanding from press reports of something that's under discussion," said Baer.
